specification.preconditions: grid.length ≥ 2 ∧ (∀ r ∈ grid, r.length = grid.length) ∧ grid.flatten.isPerm (List.range' 1 (grid.length * grid.length)) ∧ k ≥ 1
specification.postconditions: (∃ w ∈ walksOf grid.length k, w.map (cellAt grid) = result) ∧ ∀ w ∈ walksOf grid.length k, ¬ (w.map (cellAt grid) < result)

metadata.note: stated as the problem states it: the lexicographically least among all walks of length k (evaluated on grids up to 4x4 and k <= 9)
